}}'''Megana''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Megana}}

==Activities==
[[Feraighin]] tells [[Rand]] that Megana and [[Bair]] set watches on every way he could possibly take to return to the city of [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]], though they don't have much hope of success.{{ref/book|7|3}}

She presumably fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley alongside the other Wise Ones during the [[Last Battle]], although she is not mentioned outside of the above.
